
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/zjdxr-up/p/19214394" title="发布于 2025-11-12 15:56">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">SNMP 请求响应报文传输分片定位</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>本文为博主原创，转载请注明出处：</p>
<p>　　在业务环境中，通过snmp轮询采集设备信息时，会偶遇 snmp 响应报文在解析过程中异常，于是采用tcpdump抓包进行报文分析。</p>
<h2>1.分片报文　</h2>
<p>　　通过tcpdump 抓包，查看响应报文得内容如下：</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1110857/202511/1110857-20251112154317074-1137998154.png" alt="image-20251017170120282" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>　　有一段很关键得报文内容如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">6876</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">2025-10-16 15:56:25.677396</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">172.16.25.13</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">172.16.11.102</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">IPv4</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">1516</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Fragmented IP protocol (proto=UDP 17, off=0, ID=007b)</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></pre>
</div>
<p>　　这段报文得主要内容：</p>
<table class="md-table" style="height: 289px; width: 968px">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">字段</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">值</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">含义</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">序列号</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">6876</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">报文在捕获中的编号</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">时间戳</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">2025-10-16 15:56:25.677396</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">精确到微秒的捕获时间</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">

<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">172.16.25.13</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">发送方IP地址</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">目的IP</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">172.16.11.102</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">接收方IP地址</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">协议</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">IPv4</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">网络层协议</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">长度</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">1516 bytes</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">报文总长度</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block md-focus-container">
<td><span class="td-span" style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><span class="md-plain">详细信息</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span" style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><span class="md-plain">Fragmented IP protocol...</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span md-focus" style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><span class="md-plain">IP分片详情</span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h2>2.分片参数详解　</h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2.1 分片参数详解</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>Fragmented IP protocol (proto=UDP <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">17</span>, off=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, ID=007b)</pre>
</div>
<table class="md-table" style="height: 145px; width: 972px">
<thead>
<tr class="md-end-block"><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">参数</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">值</span></span></th><th><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">含义</span></span></th></tr>
</thead>
<tbody>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>proto=UDP 17</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">UDP协议，协议号17</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">传输层协议类型</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>off=0</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">分片偏移量=0</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">这是第一个分片</span></span></td>
</tr>
<tr class="md-end-block md-focus-container">
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>ID=007b</code></span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span"><span class="md-plain">分片标识符=0x007b(123)</span></span></td>
<td><span class="td-span md-focus"><span class="md-plain">同一数据包的所有分片共享此ID</span></span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">2.2 分片技术细节</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>IP分片头部字段</strong><span class="md-plain">：</span></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>总长度</strong><span class="md-plain">: 1516 bytes</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>标识</strong><span class="md-plain">: 0x007b (123)</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>分片标志</strong><span class="md-plain">: MF=1 (More Fragments，还有后续分片)</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>分片偏移</strong><span class="md-plain">: 0 (这是第一个分片)</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3. 网络流量分析</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3.1 通信方向</span></h3>
<pre class="md-fences md-end-block ty-contain-cm modeLoaded"><span>172.16.25.13 → 172.16.11.102</span></pre>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>源</strong><span class="md-plain">: 172.16.25.13 (可能是客户端或服务请求方)</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>目的</strong><span class="md-plain">: 172.16.11.102 (可能是服务器或服务提供方)</span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">3.2 分片原因分析</span></h3>
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>为什么需要分片</strong><span class="md-plain">：</span></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>MTU限制</strong><span class="md-plain">: 路径上某个链路的MTU小于1516字节</span></span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-pair-s "><strong>常见MTU值</strong><span class="md-plain">: </span></span></p>
<ul class="ul-list" data-mark="-">
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">以太网: 1500字节</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">PPPoE: 1492字节</span></p>
</li>
<li class="md-list-item">
<p class="md-end-block md-p"><span class="md-plain">隧道协议: 更小值</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span class="md-pair-s md-expand"><strong>计算</strong><span class="md-plain md-expand">：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">原始UDP数据包:
[IP头20][UDP头8][数据1488] </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 总长1516字节

分片后:
分片1: [IP头20][UDP头8][部分数据] </span>+ 分片标志MF=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, Offset=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
分片2: [IP头20][剩余数据] </span>+ 分片标志MF=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span>, Offset=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1480</span>/<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>=<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">185</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">4.2 协议栈层次</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">应用层数据
    ↓
UDP头部 (8字节)
    ↓  
IP头部 (20字节) </span>+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 分片信息
    ↓
网络传输</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">5. 可能的应用场景</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain">5.1 常见的UDP大包应用</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># DNS响应 (通常不会这么大)
# NTP协议
# SNMP Trap
# TFTP文件传输
# 视频流媒体
# 自定义UDP应用</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">5.2 网络诊断</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 检查路径MTU
ping </span>-M <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">do</span> -s <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1472</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">172.16</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11.102</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  # 测试MTU

# 使用traceroute检查路径
traceroute </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">172.16</span>.<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">11.102</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">6. 网络优化建议</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain">6.1 避免分片的方法</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 调整应用层数据大小
应用程序设置: MTU </span>- IP头 - UDP头 = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1500</span> - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">20</span> - <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span> =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> 1472字节

# 系统级MTU配置
ifconfig eth0 mtu </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1500</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain">6.2 监控建议</span></h3>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"># 监控分片统计
netstat </span>-s | grep -<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">i fragment

# 使用tcpdump持续监控
tcpdump </span>-i any -n <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">host 172.16.25.13 and host 172.16.11.102</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span></pre>
</div>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading"><span class="md-plain">7. 解决方法</span></h2>
<p><strong><span class="md-plain">　　1.设置调整路由设备得mtu值</span></strong></p>
<p><strong><span class="md-plain">　　2. 设置snmp 采集轮询中每次walk数据量得大小；即设置 snmp 在 getBulk时得&nbsp;<strong>MaxRepetition 参数，将这个参数调小，每次响应得数据变小，就可以正常响应了。</strong></span></strong></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
</div>
